scope: Full frozen benchmark usage is separate from the two saved midterm pilots; setup/preflight calls not in these result files are excluded.
primary_policy: First recorded attempts; retries additionally summarized; known calls within partially unknown attempts are retained.

pricing_source.verified_by: parent task against official Azure primary source

pricing_formula: (known input - recorded cached input)*input rate + recorded cached input*cached rate + known output*output rate, divided by 1e6
pricing_assumptions: Scenario rates do not establish the actual deployment region, SKU, agreement, taxes or Azure invoice.
All known calls are below the quoted 272,000-input-token short-context threshold.
Base scenarios assume recorded cached tokens receive the cached-input rate and make no unrecorded cache-write adjustment.
Cache-write counts and billing semantics are not stored; the all-uncached-as-write replacement scenario is conditional, not an invoice bound.
The no-cached-discount comparison prices all recorded input at the input rate; it excludes unknown timeout usage and cache-write changes.
One timed-out call has unavailable provider usage and is not estimated as zero; eight earlier successful calls in that attempt remain in the known subtotal.

notes: Azure SDK model_dump usage is preserved by the LiteLLM ModelResponse conversion; prompt/completion and prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens are recorded per response.
Row input/output/cached totals exactly equal per-call sums; total equals input+output and model-call counts equal per-call entry counts.
SDK max_retries=0; the common budget path passes safe_llm_call max_retries=1. No automatic SDK/model retries or recorded question retries occurred.
Calls blocked before dispatch by aggregate budget or the 32k guard do not increment network-call counters.

The cached field is present in saved call records, but zero defaults when the original usage/detail field is absent. Upstream cache-detail presence was not separately persisted, so recorded zero cannot distinguish no caching from missing detail.
Cache-write usage and raw response usage objects are not retained. Repeated prompt is an estimate and is not deducted from billed input; only recorded cached input receives a scenario discount.

Traces include synthetic assistant field-check tool entries. After excluding those recognized entries, model-response assistant counts exactly match all known provider-response calls. The sole timeout has no returned response; dispatch counters remain the accounting source.
All saved monetary costs are null by deliberate Azure adapter policy, not actual zero charges.

illustrative_240_trial_pilot.basis: Each strategy's ordinary first-attempt mean input/output/cached usage; proposed variants and repetitions may differ substantially.
illustrative_240_trial_pilot.ceiling_assumptions: 240 trials × 200,000 tokens × $0.50/M assumes every billed token obeys the recorded ceiling, Global short-context rates and no unknown/extra billed usage; not an invoice guarantee.
